public_architecture_observations.abstract_pattern: Specialized security roles coordinate under approved procedures with analyst oversight.
public_architecture_observations.szl_transformation: Aegis Proof Cells use Tenant Passports, Evidence Atoms, Procedure Capsules, and Decision Receipts.

public_architecture_observations.abstract_pattern: Investigation context must accumulate across specialist handoffs.
public_architecture_observations.szl_transformation: Aegis Evidence Groups preserve evidentiary, procedural, investigative, decision, and outcome context.

public_architecture_observations.abstract_pattern: Structured, reusable investigation observations should replace unstructured handoff prose.
public_architecture_observations.szl_transformation: Evidence Atoms are typed, source-labelled, freshness-bound records grouped into a Proof Chain.

public_architecture_observations.abstract_pattern: Agent actions need an independent control layer and complete auditability.
public_architecture_observations.szl_transformation: Aegis applies deny-by-default Covenant Policy, hard-zero safety gates, human approvals, and effectors disabled.

public_architecture_observations.abstract_pattern: Proven operational configurations should be packaged as governed reusable assets.
public_architecture_observations.szl_transformation: Versioned Procedure Capsules carry scope, prerequisites, cell graph, evidence contract, and approval requirements.

public_architecture_observations.abstract_pattern: Multi-tenant procedures need explicit credential and environment segmentation.
public_architecture_observations.szl_transformation: Tenant Passport labels select connector classes only; credentials are never accepted by this client-side workbench.
